description: This file defines a class named DialogModel used to represent a dialog's data structure, including its key, UI name, and a list of fields. It also contains a nested class Field representing individual form fields.

classes.name: DialogModel
classes.description: Represents a dialog with a key, UI name, and list of fields.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a single field within the dialog, identified by key and UI name.

methods.name: DialogModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog with key, UI name, and list of fields.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields in the dialog.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DialogModel object.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Constructor initializing a field with key and UI name.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the field.

methods.name: getUiName
methods.description: Returns the UI name of the field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Field object.
